name: TrES-2
description: Star of 5,850 K, 215 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: TrES-2 b crosses TrES-2 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): st_teff 5850, st_rad 1.12, st_mass 1.36

quotes.title: TrES-2b
quotes.card: TrES-2b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star TrES-2A located 750 light years away from the Solar System.
quotes.introduction: The planet was identified in 2011 as the darkest known exoplanet, reflecting less than 1% of any light that hits it.
